title: sempervivum tectorum subsp. montanum
intro: Sempervivum tectorum subsp. montanum, commonly known as Hens and Chicks, is a subspecies of succulent plants belonging to the Crassulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, offering benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sempervivum tectorum subsp. montanum include soothing skin irritations and promoting tissue repair, while its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
